description.zh:
* 是否合并PDF的**前几页**，并返回合并页的识别结果（最大支持返回**前4页**识别结果）。例如上传的PDF有**3页**，且设置此参数为**true**，返回前**3页**所有识别结果。
* 默认为**false**。
* 如果上传的PDF总页数大于**4页**，且设置此参数为**true**，则只识别**前4页**（此参数不支持选择任意页码号）。
* 如果设置了 **PageNo**，同时 **MergePdfPages** 设置为**true**，则 **MergePdfPages** 不生效，会识别 **PageNo** 指定的PDF页面。
description.en:
* Specifies whether to merge the **first few pages** of a PDF and return the merged recognition result (supports up to the **first 4 pages**). For example, if a PDF has **3 pages** and this parameter is set to **true**, the recognition results of the first **3 pages** are returned.  
* The default value is **false**.  
* If the total number of pages in the uploaded PDF exceeds **4** and this parameter is set to **true**, only the **first 4 pages** are recognized (this parameter does not support selecting arbitrary page numbers).  
* If **PageNo** is specified and **MergePdfPages** is set to **true**, **MergePdfPages** is ignored, and only the page specified by **PageNo** is recognized.

description.zh:
* 待识别的PDF/OFD页码。
* 如果字段为空，或大于PDF/OFD总页数，则识别第一页。
* 使用SDK设置此字段，请更新SDK版本。
description.en:
* The page number of the PDF/OFD file to be recognized.  
* If this field is empty or greater than the total number of pages in the PDF/OFD file, the first page is recognized.  
* To use this field with an SDK, update your SDK version.

description.zh:
* 本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）。
description.en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive—you cannot pass through both or leave both empty.  
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; base64 is not supported).

description.zh:
* 本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
* 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
* 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可。
description.en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive—you cannot pass through both or leave both empty.  
* Binary image file, up to 10 MB.  
* When using HTTP, upload the binary image file in the HTTP body.  
* When using an SDK, place the image in the SDK body.

descriptions.zh:
#### 本接口适用场景 * 阿里云混贴发票识别，是阿里云官方自研OCR文字识别产品，适用于获取多种发票集合在一个页面的场景，需要获取多种发票上的关键信息。 * 阿里云OCR产品基于阿里巴巴达摩院强大的AI技术及海量数据，历经多年沉淀打磨，具有服务稳定、操作简易、实时性高、能力全面等几大优势。 * 本接口图片示例

#### 本接口核心能力 |分类 |概述| |---|---------| |图像增强|默认支持图像增强，包括图像自动旋转、畸变自动矫正、模糊图片自动增强等能力。| |全字段识别|智能识别混贴发票上所包含的全部字段。| |多类型覆盖|支持模糊、光照不均、透视畸变、任意背景等低质量图像识别。| |高精度识别|总体识别准确率可达98%。| #### 如何使用本接口 |步骤|概述| |--|---| |1|开通 [票据凭证识别](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_invoice_public_cn) 服务。开通服务前后，您可以通过[体验馆](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=bill&subtype=multi_invoice#intro)免费体验本功能识别效果。| |2|购买[混贴发票识别资源包](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_invoice_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_invoice_dp_cn_20211103182712_0880%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D)。本API会赠送免费额度，可使用免费额度测试。您也可以不购买资源包，系统会通过“[按量付费](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html)”方式按实际调用量自动扣款。| |3|可以参照[调试页面](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeMixedInvoices?lang=PHP&sdkStyle=dara)提供的代码示例完成API接入开发。接入完成后，调用API获取识别结果。如果使用子账号调用接口，需要阿里云账号（主账号）对RAM账号进行授权。创建RAM用户的具体操作，请参考：[创建RAM用户。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html)文字识别服务提供一种系统授权策略，即**AliyunOCRFullAccess**。具体授权操作，请参见[在用户页面为RAM用户授权。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html)| #### 重要提示 |类型|概述| |----|-------------------| |图片格式|
  • 本接口支持：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、TIFF、WebP、PDF、OFD。
| |图片尺寸|
  • 图片长宽需要大于15像素，小于8192像素。
  • 长宽比需要小于50。
  • 如需达到较好识别效果，建议长宽均大于500px。
  • 图片尺寸过小，会影响识别精度。图片内单字大小在10-50px内时，识别效果较好。
| |图片大小|
  • 图片二进制文件不能超过10MB。
  • URL长度不能超过2048。
  • 图片过大会影响接口响应速度，建议使用小于1.5M图片进行识别，且通过传图片URL的方式调用接口。
| |当前支持的发票类型|增值税发票、火车票、机票行程单、出租车票、定额发票、增值税发票卷票、机动车销售发票、网约车行程单、二手车销售统一发票、通用机打发票、客运车船票、过路过桥费发票、社会保障卡、税收完税证明、支付详情页、电商详情页、酒店流水、非税收入发票。| |相关能力|
  • [云市场混贴票据识别。](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57124001/cmapi00034969.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6dcb4dcdy2b5CR#sku=yuncode2896900002)

descriptions.en:
#### Scenarios for This API * Alibaba Cloud Mixed Invoice Recognition is an official self-developed OCR product that applies to scenarios where multiple types of invoices are pasted together on a single page, and key information from these invoices needs to be extracted. * Powered by DAMO Academy’s advanced AI technology and vast data resources, Alibaba Cloud’s OCR products have been refined over years of development and offer advantages such as service stability, ease of use, high real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API:

#### Core Capabilities of This API | Category | Overview | |---|---------| | Image Enhancement | Supports image enhancement by default, including automatic image rotation, distortion correction, and enhancement of blurry images. | | Full-field Recognition | Intelligently recognizes all fields present on mixed invoices. | | Multi-type Coverage | Supports recognition of low-quality images, including blurry images, uneven lighting, perspective distortion, and arbitrary backgrounds. | | High-accuracy Recognition | Achieves an overall recognition accuracy rate of up to 98%. | #### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | |--|---| | 1 | Activate the [Bill and Voucher Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_invoice_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can experience this feature for free via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=bill&subtype=multi_invoice#intro). | | 2 | Purchase a [Mixed Invoice Recognition resource plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_invoice_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_invoice_dp_cn_20211103182712_0880%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API includes a free quota for testing. Alternatively, you may choose not to purchase a resource plan; the system will automatically charge based on actual usage under the [pay-as-you-go](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html) billing model. | | 3 | Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeMixedInvoices?lang=PHP&sdkStyle=dara) to integrate the API. After integration, invoke the API to obtain the classification result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, the Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM User](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For details on authorization, see [Grant Permissions to a RAM User on the User Page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | |----|-------------------| | Image Format |
  • This API supports the following formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, WebP, PDF, and OFD.
| | Image Dimensions |
  • Both height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (height-to-width or width-to-height) must be less than 50.
  • For optimal recognition results, it is recommended that both dimensions exceed 500 pixels.
  • Images that are too small may reduce recognition accuracy. Best results are achieved when individual characters in the image are between 10 and 50 pixels in size.
| | Image Size |
  • The binary file of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • The URL length must not exceed 2048 characters.
  • Excessively large images may slow down API response time. It is recommended to use images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoke the API by passing an image URL.
| | Supported Invoice Types | VAT invoices, train tickets, airline itinerary receipts, taxi receipts, fixed-amount invoices, VAT invoice rolls, motor vehicle sales invoices, ride-hailing itinerary receipts, second-hand vehicle sales unified invoices, general machine-printed invoices, passenger transport tickets (bus and ship), toll and bridge fee invoices, social security cards, tax payment certificates, payment detail pages, E-commerce detail pages, hotel transaction records, and non-tax revenue invoices. | | Related Capabilities |
  • [Mixed Bill Recognition on Alibaba Cloud Marketplace](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57124001/cmapi00034969.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6dcb4dcdy2b5CR#sku=yuncode2896900002).
